_doc: Required/optional asset inventory for the copy-only static build (ADR-2002). The build previously staged repo image directories with `cp ... || true`, so a completed build certified nothing about the media actually present. Every entry under `required` MUST exist in dist/ after a build or the build fails; every entry under `optional` is staged best-effort and its presence or absence is recorded explicitly in the build receipt. Adding a new hard dependency to the page means adding it here, not relying on the copy step happening to succeed.

required.why: sole module entrypoint, referenced by index.html
WebGL2 mesh module imported by js/main.js
og:image / twitter:image social card referenced by index.html
background video source referenced by index.html
background video source referenced by index.html

optional.why: architecture diagrams staged for deep links and future figures; the page does not reference them today
generated concept art staged for deep links; not referenced by the page today
hero imagery staged for deep links and future layouts; not referenced by the page today
product screenshots staged for deep links; the og:image is copied from here as a required asset

derived.why: social-card image. Sourced from the repo screenshot set rather than duplicated into static/, so the card cannot silently diverge from the shipped product shot.
